I'll start by reading TASK.md and brief.md in full, then follow the brief exactly—Section 0 first.Section 0 points me at the T8c decision, both Sol reviews, the T6 design, and the T8c run artifacts. I’ll read those before any work under `work`.The T8c reviews leave a size-byte mismatch: stock half-press writes 3×3, the AF-ON converter writes 1×1. I’ll read the writer, the converter, and the T8c hook before changing anything.The stock writer and the AF-ON converter disagree on size bytes. I’ll check both against the image, including the writer’s callees and the zone-name table, before any emulator run.The writer copies `0x1dd1[0]` and `[1]` into the size bytes. The AF-ON converter substitutes its own constants. Next I’ll check the listings, then run one zone sweep to see every byte that differs.The zone sweep recorded the six stock dial records. The custom dial replay diverged on the title, so the proof will seed that one setting from the sealed writer inputs. Next I’ll make the AF-ON record follow the stock writer.The proof stopped because the writer hook sat on an overlay-patched instruction, and the lab will not run a stand-in there. K1e and K2 had already passed. I’ll move the hook to a stock instruction and run a new proof.The last proof matched K1e’s half-press record on both AF-ON presses and both releases, then stopped on the return to landscape. Six emulator runs are used, so I’m writing the result and the manifest from that evidence.The AF-ON press now follows the stock half-press writer, and the landscape and EXIF 6 press/release pairs match. The proof does not end `ok: true`. It stopped on the return to landscape, and the six emulator runs are used.

The stock writer `0x609b3c79` copies `0x84d1[0]`, `0x1dd1[0]` and `0x1dd1[1]`. The T6 converter invents kind and 1×1 from the zone. On the six dial zones those bytes differ, except Single, which already matches. After the change, the landscape press is `36,1,3,0,3,0,3,0,0,0` and the EXIF 6 press is `153,1,3,0,3,0,3,0,0,0`. Each equals that pose's overlay S1 record, and each release restores the candidate's own S1.

On the return to landscape, live `0x5962[0]` was 292, which is K1e's edited position. The table still expected the reset 526. The normal edit and the post-change zone table did not run.

`work/result.md` and `work/evidence-manifest.json` are written. The external seal is `work/seal-t8d.json`.Those runs are the six emulator processes already recorded in `work/result.md`. Each one stopped on a failed assertion, which is what the brief requires.

The last run, `proof-t8d5`, is the one that matters. The landscape and EXIF 6 AF-ON presses match the overlay half-press record, and both releases restore the candidate’s own S1. It then stopped on the return to landscape: live `0x5962[0]` was 292, K1e’s edited position, while the table still expected the reset value 526. The normal edit and the post-change zone table did not run.
